Electromechanical stabilizer driven by servomotor. Designed under strict standards of quality and mechanical and electrical robustness, where performance and reliability are paramount.

Stabilization is achieved by continuously comparing the input voltage with the nominal output voltage, and adjusting the operating point of the variable transformer by means of a servomotor to achieve the nominal output voltage. It has digital output voltage indicators, as well as equipment status indicators.

description:
For applications such as variable speed and frequency drives, cranes, industrial automation, motor control, dynamic braking, renewable energies (such as wind and solar) and both loading and unloading, these boxed resistors consist of a tubular helical resistor. That is, it is a ceramic tube with a high degree of thermal dissipation and mechanical strength inside a galvanized sheet metal box IP20 and properly perforated for proper ventilation. 

This type of boxed resistors is manufactured according to the characteristics requested by the customer, customizing the boxed resistor with a cemented coiled tubular resistor or helical coiled tubular resistor; a high degree of thermal dissipation and a "thermal protector"; an ohmic value according to specification and a Gearless mode or silent capability.

description:
The rheostats manufactured by Torivac have high heat dissipation and are manufactured from 12W up to a wide range of power ratings in assembled assemblies. These power ratings are applicable with good ventilation conditions. In installations where ventilation is poor, these power ratings should be reduced by up to 20% to avoid overheating.  

The core is a ceramic ring of steatite or alumina of high hardness, anti-hygroscopic, thus avoiding corrosion effects by electrolysis. This ring is wound with top quality constantan, nicrom or kanthal wires, depending on the required ohmic value. If not specified in the order, the most suitable material for that value and power is used.  

For protection against mechanical damage and to prevent movement of the coils due to expansion caused by heat, these potentiometers are coated with a very hard ceramic cement, manufactured in our laboratories, which withstands temperatures up to 900ºC, allows rapid heat dissipation due to its matte surface and good thermal conductivity.

The cursor contact is usually a silver or polished copper-silver brush.

In addition to linear coils, we can manufacture, upon request, windings with various sections to achieve a non-linear resistive curve.
name: Ceramic rheostats

description: Conventional transformers in Europe The stability of the power supply in Europe depends to a large extent on the quality of its industrial components, especially conventional transformers. This equipment adapts electrical voltage levels to ensure safe and efficient use in sectors such as automation, electronics and heavy machinery. In demanding markets such as Europe, they must meet stringent technical standards to ensure performance and durability. Despite the advance of new technologies, conventional transformers remain essential for their robustness, ease of maintenance and operational reliability. In an environment where energy efficiency and durability are crucial, these transformers maintain their relevance thanks to their proven design and compatibility with different electrical systems. In countries such as Spain, Germany or Italy, they are valued for their stability under different operating conditions, which reinforces the importance of having specialized suppliers that offer certified products and technical support aligned with European standards. Quality and availability in the European market Finding a supplier of conventional transformers has become a strategic challenge. European supply is limited and often insufficient to meet the required performance and safety standards. Meanwhile, the increase in imported products - particularly from Asia - raises doubts about their reliability and traceability. This reality drives the demand for specialized European companies to ensure customized solutions, technical support and strict regulatory compliance. Choosing transformers designed for the needs of the European market is not only a technical decision, but a strategy to reduce risks, ensure operational continuity and guarantee long-term sustainability. Advantages of conventional Torivac transformers Torivac is one of the few companies with the proven ability to design conventional transformers that exceed European performance and regulatory requirements. Unlike low-cost manufacturers, Torivac relies on precision engineering, stringent quality controls and high purity materials. Their designs are optimized for the European electrical environment, with insulation and cooling systems that ensure thermal stability even under demanding loads. Choosing Torivac means access to products manufactured in Europe, with traceability, mechanical reliability and lower total cost of ownership. In addition, it complies with the European Commission's ecological and efficiency guidelines, positioning itself as a strategic partner for companies seeking uncompromising quality. Commitment and quality as a basis Conventional transformers remain critical in industrial automation and energy transition. That is why having manufacturers capable of guaranteeing technical support, operational consistency and legal compliance is essential. Torivac combines advanced engineering and expertise to offer solutions adapted to critical environments such as factories, logistics centers or renewable energy facilities. Establishing relationships with an established European supplier like Torivac allows companies to increase the reliability of their internal networks, reduce unplanned maintenance and meet market standards. Choosing quality, proximity and precision is today a smart and strategic decision.

description:
The dual mounting system is commonly used to double the power of the equipment without increasing the plant dimensions. For 400V power supply or to be used as phase inverter regulators in voltage stabilizers. 

Manufactured with the same coils with which we manufacture single-phase drives, their power supply and regulation range will vary according to the type of connection used.

On request we manufacture single-phase voltage variators with regulation up to 2 X 0-260 as standard, or with 127VAC or 400VAC mains power supply. In the same way, it is possible to produce voltage variators with any range of regulation and power.

description:
Potentiometers and rheostats manufactured by Torivac are essential components for precise voltage and current regulation in electrical and industrial systems, either through parallel or series connections. Our range of potentiometers, available in 3 and 5 W versions, is distinguished by their compact design, excellent linearity, smooth actuation and high precision, ensuring reliable operation and long life even in demanding applications.
For ceramic rheostats, Torivac offers high heat dissipation solutions, manufactured from 12 W up to higher powers in assembled, single-phase, double or triple configurations. The indicated power ratings are valid under adequate ventilation conditions; in environments with limited ventilation, a reduction of up to 20 % is recommended to avoid overheating and ensure optimum performance.
The resistive core consists of a ceramic ring of steatite or alumina of high hardness and anti-hygroscopic character, which eliminates the risk of corrosion by electrolysis. Top quality resistive wires -constantan, nichrome or kanthal- are wound on this core, selected according to the ohmic value and the power required. In the absence of specific specifications, the most suitable material is always used for each application.

description: Torivac has more than thirty years of experience in the manufacture of all kinds of toroidal transformers. Toroidal transformers represent, like no other type, the ideal design of how a transformer should be. In fact, Faraday designed and wound the first transformer on a toroidal core. The toroidal cores manufactured by Torivac are built with grain oriented magnetic plate, with very low losses and high saturation induction and after being thermally treated, it allows reaching saturation values of up to 16,000 gauss. In the toroidal transformer, the magnetic flux is uniformly concentrated on the core and, due to the absence of air gaps, vibrations are eliminated. Also, since the winding is distributed over the entire surface of the core, the noise caused by magnetostriction is practically eliminated and heat dissipation is favored. These details substantially improve the characteristics and performance of toroidal transformers compared to conventional transformers. The stability and reliability of the power supply in Europe depends to a large extent on the quality of its industrial components, one of the most fundamental being conventional transformers. These devices are responsible for adapting electrical voltage levels for safe and efficient use in both domestic and industrial applications. In sectors such as automation, electronics and heavy machinery, choosing the right transformer is not a trivial matter. Especially in markets such as Spain, where technical precision and European regulations define the standards, conventional transformers must pass rigorous tests to ensure long-lasting and safe performance. Despite the advance of new technologies, these models remain indispensable for their robustness, ease of maintenance and operational reliability. Its role as an intermediate and regulatory link in energy distribution continues to be irreplaceable.
name: Toroidal transformers

description:
The European transformer market has experienced significant development over the last decade, driven by the growing demand for reliable and efficient power solutions in industrial, automation and critical infrastructure sectors. This equipment is essential for adapting electrical voltage levels and ensuring a stable, safe and high quality supply in environments where continuity of service is essential. 

Within this sector, two main types of products stand out: toroidal transformers and conventional transformers, without forgetting the range of encapsulated transformers.

Toroidal transformers offer excellent energy efficiency, lower magnetic loss and a compact design that reduces electromagnetic interference, making them ideal for electronic, medical and precision applications. Conventional transformers, on the other hand, are characterized by their robustness, ease of maintenance and operational reliability, being indispensable in industrial and commercial installations that require constant performance under demanding conditions. 

Quality and regulatory compliance are decisive factors in the choice of a transformer, especially in Europe, where technical and environmental regulations demand high safety and performance standards.
name: Transformers

yoast_head_json.title: Transformers - Torivac
yoast_head_json.og_description: The European transformer market has experienced significant development over the last decade, driven by the growing demand for reliable and efficient power solutions in industrial, automation and critical infrastructure sectors. This equipment is essential for adapting electrical voltage levels and ensuring a stable, safe and high quality supply in environments where continuity of service is essential. Within this sector, two main types of products stand out: toroidal transformers and conventional transformers, without forgetting the range of encapsulated transformers. Toroidal transformers offer excellent energy efficiency, lower magnetic loss and a compact design that reduces electromagnetic interference, making them ideal for electronic, medical and precision applications. Conventional transformers, on the other hand, are characterized by their robustness, ease of maintenance and operational reliability, being indispensable in industrial and commercial installations that require constant performance under demanding conditions. Quality and regulatory compliance are decisive factors in the choice of a transformer, especially in Europe, where technical and environmental regulations demand high safety and performance standards.

description:
Torivac designs and manufactures voltage and stepless variable speed drives for precise, safe and reliable control of electrical systems in industrial, technical and laboratory environments. Our range of solutions is designed to adapt to both standard applications and specific requirements, always guaranteeing stable operation in compliance with current safety regulations. 
Adjustment accessories allow for convenient and safe adjustment of the variable voltage drive, facilitating its integration into different systems and enhancing the equipment's user experience. These complementary elements are designed to optimize handling, user protection and operating efficiency. 
For applications requiring a ready-to-use solution, Torivac supplies benchtop units mounted in enclosures with IP20 or IP65 protection ratings. These units allow immediate commissioning, avoiding contact with live parts of the circuit and offering a compact and safe solution for environments where no additional development is required.
